description: 会话迁移与导入导出：扫描 ~/.omp/agent/sessions 与 ~/.pi/agent/sessions 的历史会话一键导入，导出任一会话为 .jsonl 备份，也能上传别处导出的 .jsonl（重名可选覆盖 / 另存副本）。
descriptionEn: Migrate and move sessions: scan ~/.omp/agent/sessions and ~/.pi/agent/sessions and import them, export any session as .jsonl, and import an uploaded .jsonl from another machine (overwrite / copy on duplicate).
